title: Collection hub — composition
question: Details · Events · Settings is locked. Which composition should the build follow inside Honest Clubhouse / event-hub grammar?

options.label: Overview-led Details
options.thesis: Details owns a two-column overview (cover | About). Membership lives only on Events. Edit / Change photo / Add open drawers.
options.viewport: Quiet header + tabs. Details: preview card, share row, Visibility. Events: flush lists. Settings: privacy + delete.
options.risk: Organisers must switch to Events to see membership — same as event hub sending attendees to Registrations.

options.label: Details + membership glance
options.thesis: Full-width cover on Details, then a short membership preview list. Full manage still on Events.
options.viewport: Details stacks cover → meta → preview rows → Visibility. Events remains the edit surface for Add/Remove.
options.risk: Two membership surfaces can feel duplicated if the preview is too long.

options.label: Events-stage priority
options.thesis: Same shell; build emphasis on Events flush lists (filters, yellow Add, Remove) as the signature surface — Details stays quieter overview-led.
options.viewport: Details overview as Comp A but lighter. Events is the craft focus: catalogue rows, Add panel.
options.risk: Details may feel underworked if Events absorbs all craft attention.
